title: potentilla arbuscula var. glabrata
intro: Potentilla arbuscula var. glabrata, commonly known as dwarf potentilla or shrubby cinquefoil, is a shrubby perennial plant belonging to the rose family (Rosaceae). This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, inflammation, and gastrointestinal problems, due to its health benefits in reducing fever and alleviating gastrointestinal discomfort. The therapeutic actions of Potentilla arbuscula var. glabrata include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral activities, which contribute to its use in treating infections and wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
